mapper.sql: id, phone, code, scene, ip, is_used, verify_fail, expire_time, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_sms_code WHERE phone = #{phone} AND scene = #{scene} AND is_used = 0 AND expire_time > NOW() ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_sms_code WHERE phone = #{phone} AND DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_sms_code WHERE ip = #{ip} AND DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_sms_code WHERE expire_time < NOW()
